description: New York City's medical examiner ruled that Jeffrey Epstein died by suicide in his Manhattan jail cell while awaiting trial on sex trafficking charges, after reviewing autopsy findings and investigative information. The death triggered intense scrutiny of the Metropolitan Correctional Center, with reports of serious lapses in required monitoring, possible falsified logs, staffing shortages, and limited cooperation from some staff during the federal investigation. Officials, including the Justice Department and FBI, continued probing the jail's "irregularities" while prosecutors shifted attention to potential charges against people who may have helped recruit or enable Epstein's abuse. The ruling also came amid ongoing civil litigation, including new lawsuits alleging Epstein recruited and sexually abused young women, while disputed autopsy details fueled public speculation despite experts noting such findings can occur in suicides.
headline: NYC Medical Examiner Rules Epstein's Death as Suicide by Hanging
